Trainee Aircraft Crashes in UP, Pilot Injured; DGCA Investigates

A trainee aircraft crashed near a road in Kasganj, Uttar Pradesh, resulting in an injury to the trainee pilot. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) has ordered a technical investigation into the incident. The outcome of the DGCA's report will determine further actions.
